title: Lieutenant Shepard
notes: Before the first call she defers: Shepard's story is Shepard's (CAPTAIN.md 4.6, 9.2).
After it, she is glad and dry about it. After STAY, the February argument from the
other side: she ordered Shepard up on an open channel and was refused. Tier 1 closes
once they have met, so it does not stay NEW for a player who never needed it.

lines.text: Lucy Shepard. Cultural survey. The shuttle you came up in is hers.
She'll want to talk to you herself. I'll let her.
It's her story before it's mine. She'll call your shuttle.
Her logs are on the tape shelf in your cabin. Watch them.

options.text: Why is there a television in her shuttle?

lines.text: She says you can't understand a people from orbit.
She logged it as a specimen. My quartermaster logged it as clutter.
She's been calling you. Good. She needed somebody to talk to.
Somebody who's been down there. I only watched it on a screen.
If you haven't watched her logs yet, they're on your shelf.

options.text: Why did she stay down so long?
Why is there a television in her shuttle?

lines.text: She says you can't understand a people from orbit.
She logged it as a specimen. My quartermaster logged it as clutter.
I ordered her up in February. On an open channel.
She said no in front of the whole bridge, and gave her reasons.
She was right about the work. I was right about the danger.
We've agreed not to discuss which of those mattered more.
